claim: Loads three sample prompts in a separate demo workspace
sandbox: Fresh browser context; create one real prompt, enter /demo, reset it, then return to the real bank.

claim: Creates and checks typed prompts from selected sentence text
sandbox: Fresh browser context; mark a selected word, save the prompt, reload, and answer it in Practice.

claim: Works offline after the first visit
sandbox: Dedicated browser context; open /demo, wait for the service worker, reload, set offline, and reload again.

claim: Exports the sentence bank as CSV
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo; download CSV and assert its header plus one row per sample prompt.

claim: Exports and restores a JSON sentence-bank backup
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo; download Backup, leave the demo, import it into an empty real bank, and observe all sample prompts.

claim: Shows a printable practice sheet and answer key
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo; open Print and assert the worksheet plus answer key are shown.

claim: Keeps sentence and practice data on this device with no sign-in
where: Landing page, footer, Privacy page, and README
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo; complete a practice answer while recording requests, then assert every request is same-origin and no sign-in field appears.

claim: Lets visitors use sample practice free with no sign-in
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo; complete a checked practice prompt and assert that no payment field or checkout is present.
